svg.title: PT-141 (Vyleesi) side effects in the phase 3 trials
svg.desc: PT-141 (Vyleesi) side effects in the phase 3 trials. Nausea: 40% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 1.3% with placebo. Flushing: 20.3% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 0.3% with placebo. Injection site reactions: 13.2% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 8.4% with placebo. Headache: 11.3% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 1.9% with placebo. Vomiting: 4.8% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 0.2% with placebo. Darkened skin or gums: 1% with bremelanotide (Vyleesi) vs 0% with placebo.
